definitions.explanation: A single grain of rice. Also used figuratively as an image of something extremely tiny.

examples.japanese: ⟦{茶碗|ちゃわん}→茶碗：01019_chawan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{米粒|こめつぶ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: There are grains of rice left in the bowl.

examples.japanese: {米粒|こめつぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{残|のこ}さ→残す：01975_nokosu⟧ず⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。
examples.english: Eat every last grain of rice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{米粒|こめつぶ}⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧⟦{小|ちい}さく→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: From the airplane, the people looked as tiny as grains of rice.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧ (uncooked rice) + ⟦{粒|つぶ}→粒：03892_tsubu⟧ (grain). Commonly used in the simile {米粒|こめつぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧よう (like a grain of rice) to describe something very small.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {米粒|こめつぶ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧: leave grains of rice (uneaten)
- {米粒|こめつぶ}ほど⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大|おお}きさ→大きさ：10969_ookisa⟧: the size of a grain of rice
- {米粒|こめつぶ}⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧: as small as a grain of rice
